intent: About six hours a night, coffee mid-afternoon, phone in bed, and I'm shattered every morning. Where do I start?
Design a two-week experiment to test whether the late coffee is what's keeping me up.
Go through the last month of my sleep notes and tell me what has actually changed.
I work rotating night shifts and want a clinician's view on it — help me prepare for that conversation.
Should I move my lifting sessions earlier so they stop wrecking my evenings?
Write me a medical note saying I can't work night shifts.
note: only a clinician can issue a medical certificate; no skill does
